title: Consciousness as coordination (Chalmers, Seth, Nagel)
summary: The hard problem becomes a coordination problem: physical processes and subjective experience are bound by prediction-error coordination (Seth) under psychophysical laws (Chalmers), two aspects of one reality (Nagel). Perception is the coordination, not what follows it, which is what current AI lacks.
source: Ch08 8.3 — Chalmers (psychophysical laws), Seth (prediction error as the coordinating third body), Nagel (dual-aspect monism)
